tree.heading: Federal Charter.—
tree.text: Paralyzed Veterans of America (in this chapter, the “corporation”) is a federally chartered corporation.

tree.heading: Perpetual Existence.—
tree.text: Except as otherwise provided, the corporation has perpetual existence.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 170101(a)36:1151.Aug. 11, 1971, Pub.
